title: The landing's results show three conditions and the summaries are the only benchmark files in git
body: The landing's results (one card per metric, built by cardsFor in site/src/lib/bench.js) show Agent alone, With documentation (docref and doc merged) and With DD, nothing else: the owner removed the 'With documentation + DD' (docdd) condition on 2026-10-20 after it was added. When regenerating docs/benchmarks/data/bench-2026-10-fix-{opus,haiku}.summary.json with src/eval/agent/summary.js, pass --compare=docref,doc,dd2, never docdd, even when the report has it. Those two summaries are the only benchmark files committed: write-ups, reports, judge and audit files, totals and calibration stay on disk (git-ignored) and must never be force-added, because the owner had them removed from the whole git history.
not_derivable: The report files carry a docdd condition and summary.js accepts it; nothing in the code says the owner rejected that condition or that benchmark data was purged from history on purpose.

evidence.summary: LANDING and SITE.featured: the trials, the merged documentation condition and the highlighted dd2.
